<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr" dir="ltr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Maillot Barça Away Player Pro – 249 DH | Tifo Wear</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:ital,wght@1,700;1,800&family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600&family=Cairo:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--black:#000;--white:#fff;--red:#d1112b;--grey:#9a9a9a;--line:#262626;--ink:#111;
--display:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;--body:"Barlow",Arial,sans-serif;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:70px;scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font:400 17px/1.55 var(--body)}
html[lang=ar]{--display:"Cairo",sans-serif;--body:"Cairo",sans-serif}
html[lang=ar] .d{font-style:normal;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.d{font-family:var(--display);font-style:italic;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.92;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:0}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:2px}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 20px;background:var(--black);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
header img{height:44px;width:44px;border-radius:50%}
.lang{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--grey);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.lang button{background:none;border:0;color:var(--white);padding:7px 16px;font:600 14px var(--body);cursor:pointer}
.lang button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--white);color:var(--black)}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:32px;align-items:center;padding:56px 20px 96px;max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,6.2vw,76px)}
.hero p{color:#d6d6d6;max-width:46ch;margin:18px 0 26px}
.price{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:14px;margin-bottom:26px}
.price b{font-size:clamp(88px,15vw,168px);color:var(--red)}
.price span{font:600 15px var(--body);padding-bottom:18px;line-height:1.3}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--red);color:var(--white);border:0;padding:16px 34px;font:800 22px var(--display);font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;clip-path:polygon(4% 0,100% 0,96% 100%,0 100%)}
html[lang=ar] .btn{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--display)}
.btn:hover{background:#ec1c3a}
.shot{position:relative}
.shot img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover}
.perks{background:var(--red);clip-path:polygon(0 24px,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 24px),0 100%);margin-top:-48px;padding:56px 0}
.perks ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.perks li{font:800 24px/1.1 var(--display);font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase}
html[lang=ar] .perks li{font-style:normal;font-size:20px}
.perks small{display:block;font:500 15px/1.4 var(--body);text-transform:none;font-style:normal;margin-top:6px;opacity:.92}
.gallery{padding:72px 0}
.gallery h2,.order h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,56px);margin-bottom:28px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
.grid img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover}
.order{background:var(--white);color:var(--ink);padding:72px 0 80px}
.order .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:start}
.recap{border-inline-start:6px solid var(--red);padding-inline-start:20px}
.recap p{margin:10px 0}
.recap .tot{font:800 54px var(--display);font-style:italic;color:var(--red)}
form{display:grid;gap:16px}
label{font-weight:600;font-size:15px;display:grid;gap:6px}
input,select{font:400 17px var(--body);padding:14px;border:2px solid #111;border-radius:0;background:var(--white);color:var(--ink);width:100%}
input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--red)}
.err{color:var(--red);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;min-height:0}
form .btn{width:100%;clip-path:none;text-align:center}
.ok{display:none;border:2px solid #111;padding:20px}
.ok.show{display:block}
.ok pre{white-space:pre-wrap;font:15px/1.5 var(--body);margin:10px 0}
footer{background:var(--black);padding:28px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--grey);font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:820px){.hero,.order .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:32px}.perks ul{grid-template-columns:1fr}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.shot{order:-1;max-width:420px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Tifo Wear">
  <div class="lang" role="group" aria-label="Langue / اللغة">
    <button type="button" data-l="fr" aria-pressed="true">FR</button>
    <button type="button" data-l="ar" aria-pressed="false">العربية</button>
  </div>
</header>

<section class="hero">
  <div>
    <h1 class="d" data-i="h1">Maillot Barça away. Version Player Pro.</h1>
    <p data-i="sub">Le maillot extérieur noir et violet du FC Barcelone, en version player : coupe ajustée, écusson et logos brillants. Celui que portent les joueurs.</p>
    <div class="price"><b class="d">249</b><span data-i="dh">DH<br>livraison gratuite</span></div>
    <a class="btn" href="#commande" data-i="cta">Commander maintenant</a>
  </div>
  <div class="shot"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Maillot Barça away Player Pro noir et violet"></div>
</section>

<section class="perks">
  <div class="wrap"><ul>
    <li><span data-i="p1">Version Player Pro</span><small data-i="p1s">Coupe ajustée de joueur</small></li>
    <li><span data-i="p2">Livraison gratuite</span><small data-i="p2s">Aucun frais ajouté à 249 DH</small></li>
    <li><span data-i="p3">Paiement à la livraison</span><small data-i="p3s">Vous payez en recevant votre maillot</small></li>
  </ul></div>
</section>

<section class="gallery"><div class="wrap">
  <h2 class="d" data-i="gt">Les détails</h2>
  <div class="grid">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Gros plan du maillot" loading="lazy">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Écusson FCB irisé" loading="lazy">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Maillot à plat, dégradé violet" loading="lazy">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Maillot porté sur le terrain" loading="lazy">
  </div>
</div></section>

<section class="order" id="commande"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="recap">
    <h2 class="d" data-i="ot">Commandez en 1 minute</h2>
    <p data-i="o1">Maillot Barça away – Player Pro</p>
    <p data-i="o2">Livraison : gratuite</p>
    <div class="tot">249 DH</div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <form id="f" novalidate>
      <label><span data-i="ln">Nom complet</span><input name="n" autocomplete="name" required><span class="err" data-e="n"></span></label>
      <label><span data-i="la">Adresse de livraison</span><input name="a" autocomplete="street-address" required><span class="err" data-e="a"></span></label>
      <label><span data-i="lp">Téléphone</span><input name="p" type="tel" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="06 12 34 56 78" required><span class="err" data-e="p"></span></label>
      <label><span data-i="ls">Taille</span><select name="s"><option>S</option><option selected>M</option><option>L</option><option>XL</option><option>XXL</option></select></label>
      <button class="btn" type="submit" data-i="send">Confirmer ma commande</button>
    </form>
    <div class="ok" id="ok" role="status" tabindex="-1"><strong data-i="okt">Commande prête à envoyer</strong><pre id="rc"></pre><button class="btn" type="button" id="cp" data-i="copy">Copier la commande</button></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<footer>© Tifo Wear</footer>

<script>
var WHATSAPP_NUMBER="212629883394"; /* ex. 2126XXXXXXXX */
var T={fr:{h1:"Maillot Barça away. Version Player Pro.",sub:"Le maillot extérieur noir et violet du FC Barcelone, en version player : coupe ajustée, écusson et logos brillants. Celui que portent les joueurs.",dh:"DH<br>livraison gratuite",cta:"Commander maintenant",p1:"Version Player Pro",p1s:"Coupe ajustée de joueur",p2:"Livraison gratuite",p2s:"Aucun frais ajouté à 249 DH",p3:"Paiement à la livraison",p3s:"Vous payez en recevant votre maillot",gt:"Les détails",ot:"Commandez en 1 minute",o1:"Maillot Barça away – Player Pro",o2:"Livraison : gratuite",ln:"Nom complet",la:"Adresse de livraison",lp:"Téléphone",ls:"Taille",send:"Confirmer ma commande",okt:"Commande prête à envoyer",copy:"Copier la commande",e_n:"Entrez votre nom complet.",e_a:"Entrez votre adresse complète.",e_p:"Entrez un numéro valide, ex. 06 12 34 56 78.",copied:"Copié !",msg:function(v){return "Nouvelle commande – Maillot Barça away Player Pro\nNom : "+v.n+"\nAdresse : "+v.a+"\nTéléphone : "+v.p+"\nTaille : "+v.s+"\nTotal : 249 DH (livraison gratuite)"}},
ar:{h1:"قميص برشلونة الخارجي. نسخة Player Pro.",sub:"القميص الخارجي الأسود والبنفسجي لنادي برشلونة بنسخة اللاعبين: قصّة ملتصقة وشعارات لامعة. نفس القميص الذي يرتديه اللاعبون.",dh:"درهم<br>التوصيل مجاني",cta:"اطلب الآن",p1:"نسخة Player Pro",p1s:"قصّة اللاعبين الملتصقة",p2:"توصيل مجاني",p2s:"بدون أي مصاريف إضافية على 249 درهم",p3:"الدفع عند الاستلام",p3s:"تدفع عندما يصلك القميص",gt:"التفاصيل",ot:"اطلب في دقيقة",o1:"قميص برشلونة الخارجي – Player Pro",o2:"التوصيل: مجاني",ln:"الاسم الكامل",la:"عنوان التوصيل",lp:"رقم الهاتف",ls:"المقاس",send:"تأكيد الطلب",okt:"طلبك جاهز للإرسال",copy:"نسخ الطلب",e_n:"أدخل اسمك الكامل.",e_a:"أدخل عنوانك الكامل.",e_p:"أدخل رقمًا صحيحًا، مثال: 06 12 34 56 78",copied:"تم النسخ!",msg:function(v){return "طلب جديد – قميص برشلونة الخارجي Player Pro\nالاسم: "+v.n+"\nالعنوان: "+v.a+"\nالهاتف: "+v.p+"\nالمقاس: "+v.s+"\nالمجموع: 249 درهم (التوصيل مجاني)"}}};
var L="fr",$=function(s){return document.querySelector(s)};
function setL(l){L=l;document.documentElement.lang=l;document.documentElement.dir=l=="ar"?"rtl":"ltr";
document.querySelectorAll("[data-i]").forEach(function(e){e.innerHTML=T[l][e.dataset.i]});
document.querySelectorAll(".lang button").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",b.dataset.l==l)});
try{localStorage.setItem("l",l)}catch(e){}}
document.querySelectorAll(".lang button").forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){setL(b.dataset.l)}});
try{var s=localStorage.getItem("l");if(s&&T[s])setL(s)}catch(e){}
var last="";
$("#f").onsubmit=function(ev){ev.preventDefault();var f=ev.target,v={n:f.n.value.trim(),a:f.a.value.trim(),p:f.p.value.trim(),s:f.s.value},bad=false;
var ok={n:v.n.length>=3,a:v.a.length>=6,p:/^(\+212|00212|0)[5-7]\d{8}$/.test(v.p.replace(/[\s.\-]/g,""))};
["n","a","p"].forEach(function(k){var i=f[k];i.setAttribute("aria-invalid",!ok[k]);$('[data-e="'+k+'"]').textContent=ok[k]?"":T[L]["e_"+k];if(!ok[k]&&!bad){i.focus();bad=true}});
if(bad)return;last=T[L].msg(v);
if(WHATSAPP_NUMBER){window.open("https://wa.me/"+WHATSAPP_NUMBER+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(last),"_blank");}
$("#rc").textContent=last;var o=$("#ok");o.classList.add("show");o.focus();};
$("#cp").onclick=function(){var b=this;try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(last).then(function(){b.textContent=T[L].copied})}catch(e){}};
</script>
</body>
</html>
